@testing-library/react.message: Import from @ksp-gonogo/sitrep-sdk/testing instead: its render/renderHook supply the theme every kit primitive needs (pass `wrapper` to add providers on top), and it re-exports the rest of Testing Library unchanged. Testing Library also auto-cleans after every test, so a manual cleanup import/call is redundant and masks real teardown bugs. @ksp-gonogo/test-utils is the same module under an older name and is `private: true`, so an Uplink client may not use it.

@ksp-gonogo/core.message: useCommand from @ksp-gonogo/core was the legacy non-delay bridge (deleted in the unified-delay-ux plan). useCommand now means the delay-aware per-topic hook: import it from @ksp-gonogo/sitrep-client or the sitrep-sdk facade so the signal-delay UX rides along. There is no legacy escape left: useExecuteAction went with its last two callers.

@ksp-gonogo/sitrep-sdk/src.message: Import from the package root. `src/` is internal layout; the same rule ships to third parties in the SDK's own biome.json, so keep our call sites honest to it.

@ksp-gonogo/ui-kit/dist.message: Import from the package root. `dist/` is build output, not API.

@ksp-gonogo/ui/dist.message: Import from the package root. `dist/` is build output, not API.

styled-components.message: Migrated widgets carry zero bespoke CSS, compose @ksp-gonogo/ui-kit primitives + layout + tokens instead. See local_docs/telemetry-mod/ui-kit-design.md.
